_readmeStats: THE NUMBERS THAT COUNT UP. For each one: "number" is the figure itself (digits only, no quotes), "suffix" is what follows it — "+" or "%" or nothing, and "label" says what the number counts. Keep the label to 1–3 words: it sits in a narrow column.

features._readmeItems: "link" is a full web address (https://...). It opens in a new tab when the card is clicked.

showcase._readmeGallery: THE PHOTO GALLERY. "heading" is the big centered title above all three frames. Each of the three "groups" is one frame: "label" is the small caption above that frame, and "images" is its own list of photos — it shows the first one, then cycles through the rest once every 10 seconds. Add, remove, or reorder file paths inside any group's "images" list freely; a group with only one photo just shows that photo without rotating.
